{{Quote|Master Owen has sent me to find four new vaporators for the homestead. Unfortunately I've got such a bad case of dust contamination I can barely move.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Star Wars Galactic Spy">{{SWArchive|url=play/online-games/galactic-spy|text=''Star Wars Galactic Spy''|int=Star Wars Galactic Spy}}</ref>}}
'''Dust contamination''', also known as '''metal fatigue''',<ref name="Terror on the Twilight">{{TCWComicCite|6.5|Terror on the Twilight|Terror on the ''Twilight''}}</ref> was a malfunction that afflicted [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. When encrusted with dust or sand, mechanical movement was severely hindered.

[[Oil bath/Legends|Oil baths]] were usually the solution to clearing the droid parts affected.
